QUOTE: "`library/CMakeLists.txt:134` runs `scripts/generate_errors.pl` as a custom command. Its inputs are the public headers (`error_headers`) and `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`, and its output is `${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/error.c`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl with error.fmt as an input, and that it isn't hand-written.
